text:
alexa: hi team, accepted the org invite but I'm getting 404 on the repo list and a banner saying SSO required when I view the org. can't clone either: `git clone git@github.com:redwood/apps.git` -> Permission denied (publickey)
jordan: did you accept with your work account or a personal one? sometimes people accidentally accept with personal and then SSO blocks them
alexa: accepted with alexa@redwood.ai (work). I can sign in, but no auth toggle for SSO on the org page.
matt: can you run `gh auth status` and `ssh -T git@github.com`? also check Settings -> Emails on your GitHub profile so the work email is primary and verified
alexa: `gh auth status` shows logged in as alexa, SSO required
`ssh -T` -> Permission denied (publickey)
people-ops: onboarding bot: flagged - GitHub SSO not authorized for alexa. We'll troubleshoot.
jordan: sometimes browser extensions or security keys on a different account hide the "Authorize SSO" button. Try an incognito window and visit https://github.com/orgs/redwood, then look for "Authorize SSO".
alexa: incognito shows the button now! clicked it, got redirected to Okta, approved. SSO says authorized.
onboard-bot: welcome alexa! tagging infra-owners to confirm repo access.
alexa: I can now see repos and just cloned `git@github.com:redwood/apps.git` successfully. `ssh -T` now says: Hi alexa! You've successfully authenticated.
matt: good. note: if you previously registered a security key on a personal account it can intercept the flow. Recommend people-ops add to checklist: verify work email primary, try incognito, and mention security-key interference
people-ops: done - updating onboarding docs. thanks for the heads up and welcome to the team :tada:
